subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “In summer, City High School felt hotter every year.”?
options: The science teacher used a sensor to measure particles before and after the filters were turned on.
The science club used small thermometers to measure different places on campus.
The science club built a small weather station on the school roof.
The science club used the case to explain conservation.

本文可直接核對「The science club used small thermometers to measure different places on campus.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The science club built a small weather station on the school roof.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
